lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs is observed posterior to the gill slits, with centroids distributed in a staggered linear formation along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect the primary lateral blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal carina is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from a highlighted dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible across the proximal and medial sections of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. Linear markings, possibly remora-induced or superficial abrasions, are present on the mid-ventral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple symbiotic fish (remoras) are attached to the ventral and pectoral regions. Transition zone of spot morphology from dense, small pixels on the head to larger, discrete clusters on the trunk is clearly visible.
